'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.

not funded at this budget: cheaper conversions are available on the other hosts first (market price here $1.18-$1.61); it gets budget as the budget grows or if a funded host declines
